evidence_items.publisher: Martin Riddell, Ansong Ni and Arman Cohan, arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Section 4.1, Main Results; Table 2; Section 4.2, difficulty analysis

receipt.public_excerpt: Models perform significantly better when similar solutions are seen during training.

evidence_items.explanation: StarCoderBase-15.5B achieved 72% accuracy on the most training-similar tenth of MBPP questions and 22% on the least similar tenth. The authors also investigated whether difficulty explained the association; these are familiarity comparisons, not proof of verbatim copying.

receipt.public_excerpt: fails when function name is perturbed

evidence_items.explanation: ReCode demonstrates failures after task-preserving prompt changes across several code-model families. Its worst-case perturbation results corroborate substantial robustness limits, although they do not independently identify memorization as the cause.

unresolved_gaps: Neither study determines whether Roose's particular application was generated through memorized reproduction.
